images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single 16:9 visual novel background: a quiet old Andalusian town square in Tarifa, Spain, for an adaptation of The Alchemist. Whitewashed low buildings, warm terracotta roofs, a small bakery shop opening with no lettering at the far left, a simple stone bench at the far right, sunlit sandy pale ground, distant blue sky. No people or animals. Eye level, broad empty central foreground for two standing animated characters; all furniture near edges or in background. Clean dark slate outlines, flat muted creams and teal blue, restrained two-tone cel shadows, simplified manga-inspired geometric scenery. Not photorealistic or painterly. No text, symbols, logos, framing, or watermark. Period-neutral old town, no modern vehicles or electrical equipment. Wide landscape composition.

Use case illustration-story.
